title.narrative: Grants and Advice for Small and Medium Size Palestinian Businesses to Enter New Markets

description.narrative: This activity Grants and Advice for Small and Medium Size Palestinian Businesses to Enter New Markets is a component of Facility for New Market Development (FNMD) to Strengthen the Private Sector in the Occupied Palestinian Territories reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £4,997,509. It works in the following sector(s): Small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) development.
